e: From oxo- + propanoic, where "oxo-" indicates the presence of a carbonyl group and "propanoic" refers to the three-carbon chain.
From species name crinita, a similar crinitol was named at the same time in 1976.

q: Taking advantages of the broad emission bands of a Yb3+ doped calcium yttrium oxoborate (Yb:YCOB) crystal cut along the optimized direction out of principle planes with the maximum effective nonlinear coefficient, the self-frequency-doubled green light based on the self-frequency-doubling behavior of Yb:YCOB was achieved with a maximum output power of 710 mW at 523 nm..
2016, Qiannan Fang, Haohai Yu, Huaijin Zhang, Jiyang Wang, “The green light generation by self-frequency-doubled Yb:YCOB crystal”, in arXiv:
